## `ConfigChange` {#schema-configchange}

A proposed change: files to set or remove (`null`), against `base_version`. Files not named stay as they are, unless `replace` is set: then the named files are the whole config (a revert).

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `approve` | boolean | `false` | Apply even if it destroys data (plan §8.2, destructive). |
| `author` | string |  | Who makes it, for the history and the commit message. |
| `base_version` | integer | **required** |  |
| `files` | map of string |  |  |
| `propose` | boolean | `false` | Put it in the approval queue instead of applying it. |
| `replace` | boolean | `false` |  |

## `QueryDimension` {#schema-querydimension}

A field to group by.

| `grain` | string |  | For time fields: `day`, `week`, `month`, `quarter` or `year`, and for timestamps also `minute` or `hour`. |

## `QueryFilter` {#schema-queryfilter}

A condition on a field: `in`, a half-open range `from <= value < to` (either end may be left out), a window of time `relative` to now (`{"unit": "day", "last": 7}`), or for a string field the values that `contains` a text, ignoring the case of ASCII letters. Values are written as in ingested rows: decimals, dates and timestamps as strings or numbers.

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contains` | string |  | The text a string field's values contain. |
| `field` | string | **required** | `dataset.field`. |
| `from` | any |  |  |
| `in` | list of any |  |  |
| `relative` | [`RelativeWindow`](#schema-relativewindow) |  |  |
| `to` | any |  |  |

## `RelativeWindow` {#schema-relativewindow}

A window of whole periods relative to now: `last` periods of `unit`, ending with the current one, or `ago` periods before it. "The last 7 days" is `{unit: day, last: 7}` (today and the six days before it); "last month" is `{unit: month, last: 1, ago: 1}`. Periods start where grains do (weeks on Monday), in UTC.

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ago` | integer |  |  |
| `last` | integer | **required** |  |
| `unit` | [`RelativeUnit`](#schema-relativeunit) | **required** |  |

| `widget` | string | **required** | `list`, `tree`, `date_range` or `search`. |

| `widget` | string |  | A `filter` visual's list: `list` or `tree`. Its frames are the filter frames of its dimension's field. |
